error.pid_invalid_target: Heat/cool mode and target temperature must be valid.
error.pid_duplicate_climate: A selected climate device is already controlled by another room.
error.pid_invalid_parameters: Review gain settings, target limits, sample interval and setpoint rate limits.
error.climate_dry_fan_control_inputs_missing: Select a same-room humidity sensor and climate entity offering BOTH DRY and FAN_ONLY. Require environment-only or manual DRY controller, explicit climate actuation, independent hardware protections, and no competing humidity power/setpoint control.
error.climate_humidity_power_inputs_missing: Choose a verified same-room humidity sensor and dedicated humidifier/dehumidifier; allow actuation, confirm independent equipment protections and valid timings. Native humidity setpoint and automatic power drivers cannot both own this device.
error.climate_secondary_control_inputs_missing: Select a different same-room heating or cooling climate entity, enable native climate control, and opt in separately.
error.climate_fan_power_inputs_missing: Select verified same-room CO₂/PM2.5 sensors and fans, confirm independent safety protections and valid timings. Fan power and fan-speed owners cannot both be enabled.
error.climate_fan_control_inputs_missing: Enable authorized room control and select verified sensors for at least one selected fan.
error.climate_fan_sensor_invalid: Select only same-room CO₂/PM2.5 sensors and valid fan speed limits.
error.climate_humidity_control_inputs_missing: Enable authorized climate control and select a same-room humidity sensor plus humidifier/dehumidifier first.
error.climate_target_required: Select a supported climate entity assigned to this room.
error.climate_direct_actuator_not_ready: Relay/PWM/proportional drivers are still under safety testing; they cannot be enabled.
error.climate_mode_invalid: Choose auto, heat, cool or off.
error.climate_occupancy_invalid: An occupancy sensor does not belong to this room.
error.climate_deadband_invalid: Cooling target must be at least 1°C above heating target in every profile.
error.climate_attestation_required: Confirm explicitly that selected outputs are independently protected, non-compressor thermal actuators before allowing switching.
error.climate_direct_targets_invalid: Select one or two real, unique and room-assigned actuator entities of the required device type.
error.climate_direct_timing_invalid: Check sample period, PWM cycle, minimum on/off durations and maximum continuous runtime.

pid_control.name: PID climate control
pid_control.description: Explicitly pause, resume or reset a room controller. Climate modes are never switched.

action.name: Action
action.description: Pause, resume, or reset (reset stays paused)
